posts.title: Exhibition 2026
posts.description: In summer of 2026 I was invited to exhibit my work at the National Botanic Garden of Wales as part of their "Croma" exhibition of colour, alongside many talented artists using a wide variety of mediums. It was a great experience and my first time exhibiting my work. Below is a gallery of all the images which were included in the exhibition.

posts.title: Frost
posts.description: A bit parky out right now, isn't it? Another walk in the National Botanic Garden of Wales, trying to make the most of the clear, frosty weather.

posts.title: A Walk in the Gardens
posts.description: Living in Carmarthen might mean persistent traffic noise from the bypass and watching the council's rather liberal use of weedkiller right next to the river, but it does come with the upside of being only a short distance from the National Botanic Garden of Wales, which is currently in full autumn splendour.
